[[File:Vaporator_mushrooms.png|thumb|200px|Shmi Skywalker's dropped vaporator mushrooms]]
{{Quote|I know that the mushrooms are small and ugly, and they taste terrible, but sometimes they're all we have to eat out here...|A Tatooinian resident|<ref name="SWG:MT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Mushroom Thieves}} on Tatooine</ref>}}
A '''vaporator mushroom''', also known as a '''Tatooine mushroom''', was a form of edible [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]]. This particular type of [[Mushroom/Legends|mushroom]] frequently grew in the damp area around the bases of [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]] was gathering these mushrooms when she was abducted by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].

Sometimes, farmers would hire hunters to stop creatures from eating their mushrooms.<ref name="SWG:MT" />
